info.title: AccessPolicy REST API
info.description: Synthetic organization membership and role service. API-only local portfolio project. Unknown JSON/query fields rejected; JSON object bodies max16384 bytes. See docs/API.md for capability matrix and concurrency semantics.

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked, or invalid bearer token; invalid login credentials

403.description: Authenticated role cannot perform this action

404.description: Resource does not exist or organization is outside your membership

409.description: Stale version, existing membership, no change, or last owner conflict

429.description: Login window or active token limit reached

Retry-After.description: Remaining seconds for login window; token limit responses do not include this header.

500.description: Transaction failed; uncommitted changes rolled back

post.summary: Issue a one-hour Sanctum bearer token
post.description: Database-persistent global limit of 10 validly shaped login attempts per fixed 300-second window. Successful attempts count. X-Forwarded-For does not alter the limit.

patch.description: Owner manages every role; admin manages ordinary member/viewer roles only and cannot modify itself. Organization row lock protects the final owner. All target tokens are revoked atomically.

delete.summary: Remove a membership with a JSON expectedVersion body
delete.description: Send Content-Type application/json and {"expectedVersion":integer}. Owner may leave when another owner exists. Final owner cannot be removed. All target tokens are revoked across all organizations.
